## Overview

Manage Omni Skills (list, install, test, remove), plugins (create, configure), and persistent memory (search, add, clear) from the CLI.

## Quick install

```bash
npm install -g agentproxy   # or: npx agentproxy
agentproxy --version
```

## Subcommands

### `memory`

**Example:**

```bash
agentproxy memory
```
